verdict.line: You lose if you let Jax stack Empower autos and Leap Strike freely at level 2-5; you win by poking with Shock Blast and denying his all-in windows.

brief.thesis: Jax wins trades the instant his W (Empower) is off cooldown and he can land it on an auto or a Leap Strike; Jayce wins by staying at range in Cannon Stance and only entering melee range when Empower is on cooldown and Counter Strike (E) is used or baited. The 46.5% win rate over 333 games reflects a lane that is genuinely even but punishes passive or careless Jayce play harder than most matchups.

theirWindow.what: Jax will Leap Strike (Q) in with Empower active for a big burst hit plus splash damage to anyone nearby, then follow with autos. Do not stand in melee range when his W icon is lit, especially before you have Hammer Stance E (Thundering Blow) to punish the engage.

yourWindow.when: His Empower (W) and Leap Strike (Q) are both down
yourWindow.what: Walk up and poke with autos in Cannon Stance or land a Shock Blast; he has no gap-close and no damage amp, so he cannot threaten you back. This is your farm-and-harass window every single time.

start.why: 92.5% pick rate and the sustain plus early AD lets you win the poke war in Cannon Stance without losing the trade war to his Empower autos.

boots.why: Slightly higher win rate (46.8%) and the flat damage reduction blunts his empowered autos and Relentless Assault (R) attack-speed stacking in extended trades.

core.why: Builds mana for Muramana and funds the constant poke OP.GG's own tip calls for — deal damage constantly and farm.
Active haste lets you disengage or reposition the instant his Counter Strike (E) goes up, since getting caught in it while he dodges your autos is how you lose the trade.
Converts your mana into the burst damage that defines your mid-game power spike at levels 9-13.

situational.when: you are ahead and want to burst him down before he can Leap Strike away
he is building tanky and you need the armor shred plus slow to keep kiting him

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the hit-and-run poke pattern this lane demands — land a Shock Blast or auto, get the speed boost, kite away before his Empower comes back up.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the top pick at 52.8% win rate and lets you punish any overextension from Jax once his Leap Strike (Q) is down, since he has no sustain to out-heal the burn.

playing.title: Poke only when Empower is down
playing.detail: Check his W icon before every trade. If it's up, he turns any auto or Leap Strike into a big hit — back off and wait.

playing.title: Hold E for his engage, not your own
playing.detail: Thundering Blow (E) knocks him back a short distance when he Leap Strikes in, buying you space to kite rather than getting locked into melee range.

playing.title: Respect Counter Strike windows
playing.detail: When he pops E he dodges all incoming basic attacks and takes less AoE damage, then stuns on landing. Stop auto-attacking the instant he activates it and hold your own cooldowns.

playing.title: Farm first, fight second before level 6
playing.detail: OP.GG's data shows this lane is EVEN pre-6 — your job is to apply pressure through constant poke damage and clean farming, not to force kills.

playing.title: Swap to Cannon Stance for ranged trades
playing.detail: Stay in Cannon Stance whenever he's near minions to poke safely; only flip to Hammer Stance when you want to finish him with Thundering Blow or need the E knockback.

playing.title: Track Relentless Assault stacks in skirmishes
playing.detail: His R gives attack speed on hit with bonus damage every third consecutive attack. Disengage before he reaches three stacks on you.

playing.title: Use Youmuu's active to escape, not engage
playing.detail: Your haste spike exists to kite out of his all-in range, not to chase — Jax wins extended melee trades if you let him stick to you.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own tactical read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Gain control over lane by applying pressure before reaching level 6. Deal damage constantly and focus on farming. Be careful when Jax uses Counter Strike(E).
